credits.work: Vector traces of the 32 Urania's Mirror cards (items 234009 to 234041), cut into figures and placed on the stars
credits.note: Changes for this viewer: the cards' colour washes, paper, star marks and lettering removed; ink of neighbouring figures erased; figures refitted to the stars, name positions moved; stray pieces cleared on Aur, Cap, Lep, UMa, CVn, CrA, Crv, Sex, Tel; wiped star marks inside Com and Lac filled from the body tone; 12 figures shown as lines only; drawing order added.
The traces very likely follow the restorations by Adam Cuerden on Wikimedia Commons, who requests attribution (inferred from file names, not stated by the source).
